recipes.name: Simple Slow Cooker Pork Chops
ingredients_raw: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed golden mushroom soup

steps.text: Combine cream of mushroom soup, golden mushroom soup, water, onion soup mix, brown sugar, and Worcestershire sauce in a slow cooker.
Stir in potatoes, sliced onion, and sliced mushrooms. Add pork chops; turn to coat both sides in soup mixture.
Cover slow cooker. Cook on Low for 6 hours.
Spoon mushroom sauce over pork chops and potatoes to serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Simple Slow Cooker Pork Chops
raw_recipe.description: In this simple, comforting one-pot slow cooker pork chops recipe, mushrooms, potatoes, and tender pork chops are slow cooked in a creamy, oniony sauce.

review.reviewBody: This was very good. It tasted almost like a beef stew but with only pork. Next time I think I am going to add some carrots and serve with a side of cottage cheese!

I followed this recipe except for omitting the second can of condensed golden mushroom soup. I used low sodium cream of mushroom soup and added carrots. I baked in a 350 degree oven for 3 hours. It was fantastic, not too salty and the pork was pull apart tender. I seasoned the pork chops with a hefty dose of pepper before adding the other ingredients, but didn't add any extra salt.
Thanks for a good basic recipe Carrie.

I changed this a bit as I only had cream of mushroom soup and no Worcestershire sauce or brown sugar. I also used 2tbls Mrs Dash Onion and herb mix instead of the onion based on the other reviews of using onion soup mix and I wanted to make it low salt. I also used the healthy request version of the soup. Everyone loved it, even my little kids!

Excellent! I made a few changes, though. Instead of water I used vegetable broth. Only used two thick pork chops but kept the other ingredients the same. Seasoned the chops with Mrs. Dash (original)) and browned them in a skillet. Then I deglazed the pan with some white wine and added it to the other ingredients. I didn't add potatoes, but in the last hour I added some potato, spinach and cheese perogies. It was fantastic!
EXCELLENT I seared the chops first. ADDED THE WATER TO BROWNINGS IN PAN AND STIRED INTO THE SOUP MIXTURE.

Four stars as is -- five with just a couple of tweaks. I opted to brown my pork chops before adding them to the slow cooker. At the very least, they looked more appealing when served. I also seasoned them with a cajun spice mixture to give them a bit more kick. Otherwise, I proceeded as directed. The results were excellent -- the chops were tender and moist and the gravy was delicious. It received rave reviews from my family.

5/11/26 - Tried this and it was Really Good! I did add carrots and 16 oz sliced mushrooms as well as a tablespoon ranch seasoning. I think this would work equally as well with boneless chicken thighs, cutting the potatoes into eighths and cooking on low for 4 hours.

We need to be gluten-free and I have yet to find a GF Golden Mushroom condensed soup, so I used two GF regular condensed mushroom soups, replaced the water with red cooking wine and added a small can of tomato paste. I also added carrots. It came out really well. Suggest putting the pork chops on the bottom and "weigh them down" with the potatoes and carrots. Mix the other ingredients separately and pour on top. Helps to keep the chops in the sauce and not rise to the top and dry out.

This dish was good and made a hearty stew like meal. I added chopped garlic and black pepper for some extra seasoning and omitted the potatoes. After it was cooked I served it over brown rice with vegetables on the side and it went over well. A good change from a beef stew.

This dish was good and made a hearty stew like meal. I added chopped garlic and black pepper for some extra seasoning and omitted the potatoes. After it was cooked I served it over brown rice with vegetables on the side and it went over well. A good change from a beef stew.

This is going into my rotation! I liked it a lot, but I had to make some changes (which I hate to do when I try a recipe for the 1st time.) I didn't add the onion soup mix because it's too salty and I didn't have any Worcestershire sauce. I also added some carrots, and I should have used less water because it came out a bit runny and I like thick gravy. Next time I make it I will add more carrots, and another can of soup instead of the water, and black pepper.

Thank for sharing the recipe!

I forgot the potatoes and added a couple of extra pork chops. It was wonderful! Super easy. I put the pork chops in first before everything then just dumped the rest on top after mixing it in a separate bowl. I made egg noodles and served the pork chops on top. Delicious!
I omitted the water and added some fresh Garlic and Ranch dressing mix. Yum.
This is a fabulous recipe. Will be making again in the future.
Fresh Rosemary

I followed the directions and cooked it For 4 hrs. On high, then 3 hrs. On low. The pork chops were tough, some of the potato pieces were still hard, and the sauce was watery. Does anyone have any suggestions about what I could try the next time I make it? Thanks.
Good flavor, the pork chops were tender. I would make it again
No changes, it was great

We really liked it. I did add a few cloves of garlic. I did not have cream of golden mushroom and used french onion instead with a can of cream of mushroom . Like pork stew and better the second day. I’ll use carrots next time.
This was really good!!! I did not use mushrooms. I used a bag of baby carrots, onion, fresh garlic and ginger.
